StackPanel.summary: Single-column (or single-row) stacking container, a LayoutPanel subclass that arranges children along orientation.

props.classname: Class name string, "stackpanel", used to identify the control type.
props.orientation: Stacking direction; default "vertical" (stacked top to bottom), can be set to "horizontal".
props.resizeItems: Fixed to true: children are stretched along the stacking direction to fill the available space.
props.itemMargin: Outer margin per child {left, top, right, bottom} in pixels. Default {5, 5, 5, 5}.
props.noFont: Inherited from Control: when true no font object is created (pure layout container that renders no text). Defaults to true.

StackPanel:New.desc: Before construction sets rows/columns from obj.orientation (horizontal gives rows=1, columns=nil; otherwise rows=nil, columns=1), then calls the parent constructor.

StackPanel:SetOrientation.desc: Synchronizes rows/columns to the new direction first, then calls inherited.SetOrientation to actually switch it.

fileDesc: Defines StackPanel, a LayoutPanel subclass that stacks children in a single row or column, pinning the direction through rows/columns.
